ma2.source: grandMA2 User Manual 3.9 (help.malighting.com/grandMA2/en/help/). Index page: https://help.malighting.com/grandMA2/en/help/, overview pages: https://help.malighting.com/grandMA2/en/help/key_command_syntax_and_keywords.html, https://help.malighting.com/grandMA2/en/help/key_cs_general_syntax_rules.html, https://help.malighting.com/grandMA2/en/help/key_cs_helping_keywords.html, https://help.malighting.com/grandMA2/en/help/key_cs_object_keywords.html, https://help.malighting.com/grandMA2/en/help/key_cs_function_keywords.html, https://help.malighting.com/grandMA2/en/help/key_cs_all_keywords.html; one page per keyword key_keyword_<name>.html (url field of each entry). Note: help2.malighting.com keyword_overview URLs returned 404; help.malighting.com serves the same 3.9 manual.

blackout.name: Blackout
syntaxText: Blackout is a toggle function. This means that entering Blackout without any helping keyword will toggle Blackout mode on/off.

circularcopy.name: CircularCopy
syntaxText: CircularCopy moves the attribute values within your currently selected fixtures in accordance with the selection order.

clone.name: Clone
syntaxText: Clone [Source Selection-list] At [Destination Selection-list] If [Scope Object-list]

crossfade.name: Crossfade
syntaxText: Crossfade is a function that gradually activates the next step of an executor in accordance with the position of the fader.

crossfadea.name: CrossfadeA
syntaxText: CrossfadeA is a function that gradually fades down dimmer attributes of the current step of an executor in accordance with the position of the fader.

crossfadeb.name: CrossfadeB
syntaxText: CrossfadeB is a function that gradually fades in dimmer attributes of the next step of an executor in accordance with the position of the fader.

defgoback.name: DefGoBack
syntaxText: DefGoBack calls the previous cue in the selected executor.

defgopause.name: DefGoPause
syntaxText: DefGoPause pauses the current fade between cues and effects in the selected executor if the option "Link effect to rate" is on in the assign menu.

executor.name: Executor
syntaxText: Executor will turn on as soon as the fader is above zero.
Executor will turn off as soon as the fader reaches zero (ignores off-time).

pmarea.name: PMArea
syntaxText: [Store / Copy / Delete] PMArea [pixel mapper area ID].[pixel mapper output ID] / [option]
Assign PMArea [pixel mapper area ID].[pixel mapper output ID] / [parameter] = [parameter value]

profile.name: Profile
syntaxText: [Function] Profile [DMX Profile ID].[DMX Profile Point ID]
Assign Profile [DMX Profile ID].[DMX Profile Point ID] /[Parameter]=[Parameter Value]

protocol.name: Protocol
syntaxText: Assign Protocol [Network Protocol ID] . [Row ID] / [Parameter] = [Parameter Value]

remote.name: Remote
syntaxText: Assign Remote [Remote Input Type ID] . [ID] / [Parameter] = [Parameter Value]

replace.name: Replace
syntaxText: Replace [search for objects] With [replace with objects] ( If [search in objects] )

search.name: Search
syntaxText: Search [search for objects] ( At [search values] ) If [search in objects]

timecode.name: Timecode
syntaxText: A specific number of times (number between 2 and 1000)
Sync with the timecode signal instantly (on)
Execute the signal when they are reached (off)

ma3.source: grandMA3 User Manual v2.3 (help.malighting.com), index https://help.malighting.com/grandMA3/2.3/HTML/csk_general_keywords.html; per-keyword pages keyword_*.html (urls per entry)

appearance.name: Appearance
syntaxText: Assign Appearance ["Appearance_Name" or Appearance_Number] At [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number]

assign.name: Assign
syntaxText: Assign [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] At [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number]
Assign Off [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] At [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number]

autocreate.name: AutoCreate
syntaxText: AutoCreate [Source_Object] ["Source_Object_Name" or Source_Object_Number] At [Destination_Object] ["Destination_Object_Name" or Destination_Object_Number] (/Option)

commanddelay.name: CommandDelay
syntaxText: ([Function]) (Sequence ["Sequence_Name" or Sequence_Number]) Cue ["Cue_Name" or Cue_Number] CommandDelay [CommandDelay_Value]

configuration.name: Configuration
syntaxText: [Function] Configuration ["Configuration_Name or Configuration_Number] At [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number]

copy.name: Copy
syntaxText: Copy [Object] ["Source_Name" or Source_Number] At ["Destination_Name" or Destination_Number] (/Option)

cue.name: Cue
syntaxText: [Function] Sequence ["Sequence_Name" or Sequence_Number] Cue ["Cue_Name" or Cue_Number] ([Setting] ["Setting_Value"] (/Option)
Assign [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] At (Sequence ["Sequence_Name" or Sequence_Number]) Cue ["Cue_Name" or Cue_Number]

default.name: Default
syntaxText: Fixture ["Fixture_Name" or Fixture_Number] At Default (FeatureGroup ["FeatureGroup_Name" or FeatureGroup_Number])

editrecipe.name: EditRecipe
syntaxText: EditRecipe ([Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] or ["Recipe_Name" or Recipe_Number])

endif.name: EndIf
syntaxText: [Function] If [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] EndIf [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number]

exchange.name: Exchange
syntaxText: Exchange [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] At [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number]

fix.name: Fix
syntaxText: Fix (On or Off) Page ["Page_Name" or Page_Number].[Executor_Number]

generator.name: Generator
syntaxText: (Attribute ["Attribute_Name" or Attribute_Number]) At Generator ["Generator_Name" or Generator_Number]

if.name: If
syntaxText: Clone [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] At [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] If [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number]

import.name: Import
syntaxText: Import [Object] Library "File Name.xml" (If Drive [Drive_Number]) (At ["Object_Name" or Object_Number]) (/Option) ("Option_Value")

insert.name: Insert
syntaxText: Insert [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] At ["Object_Name" or Object_Number]

integrate.name: Integrate
syntaxText: Integrate Preset ["FeatureGroup_Name" or FeatureGroup_Number].["Preset_Name" or Preset_Number] Step [Step_Number]

knockin.name: KnockIn
syntaxText: Fixture ["Fixture_Name" or Fixture_Number] KnockIn ["Attribute_Name" or Attribute_Number]/["FeatureGroup_Name" or FeatureGroup_Number]

knockout.name: KnockOut
syntaxText: Fixture ["Fixture_Name" or Fixture_Number] KnockOut ["Attribute_Name" or Attribute_Number]/["FeatureGroup_Name" or FeatureGroup_Number]

macro.name: Macro
syntaxText: [Function] DataPool ["DataPool_Name" or DataPool_Number] Macro ["Macro_Name" or Macro_Number]

move.name: Move
syntaxText: Move [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] At ["Object_Name" or Object_Number]

patch.name: Patch
syntaxText: Patch Fixture ["Fixture_Name" or Fixture_Number] Thru ["Fixture_Name" or Fixture_Number]

preset.name: Preset
syntaxText: Assign [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] At Preset ["FeatureGroup_Name" or FeatureGroup_Number].["Preset_Name" or Preset_Number]

recast.name: Recast
syntaxText: Recast Preset ["FeatureGroup_Name" or FeatureGroup_Number].["Preset_Name" or Preset_Number]

remote.name: Remote
syntaxText: Assign [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object_Number] At Remote ["RemoteInputType_Name" or RemoteInputType_Number].["Remote_Name" or Remote_Number] (Property ["Property_Name"] ["Property_Value"])

remotecommand.name: RemoteCommand
syntaxText: RemoteCommand [Device_Type] ["Device_Name" or Device_Number] ["Command to be Executed"]

set.name: Set
syntaxText: Set [Object_Type] ["Target_Object_Name" or Target_Object_Number] Property ["Property_Name"] At [Object_Type] (["Source_Object_Name" or Source_Object_Number]) (Property ["Property_Name"])

setglobalvariable.name: SetGlobalVariable
syntaxText: SetGlobalVariable ["Name of Variable"] At [Object] ["Object Name" or Object Number] Property ["Property_Name"] (/Look)

setuservariable.name: SetUserVariable
syntaxText: SetUserVariable ["Name of Variable"] At [Object] ["Object_Name" or Object Number] Property ["Property_Name"] (/Look)
